name: Python Mastery Handbook
shortDescription: Advanced Python patterns for production systems.
longDescription: A comprehensive guide covering async programming, type hints, packaging, and performance tuning. Includes real-world examples from distributed systems and API design.

reviews.author: Alex Chen
reviews.comment: Clear explanations and practical examples throughout.

reviews.author: Maria Lopez
reviews.comment: Great for intermediate developers leveling up.

name: Cloud Native Architecture
longDescription: Learn service mesh, observability, and deployment strategies for cloud-native applications. Covers Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines end to end.

reviews.author: James Wright
reviews.comment: Exactly what I needed for our platform migration.

name: Data Visualization Essentials
shortDescription: Tell compelling stories with charts and dashboards.
longDescription: From choosing the right chart type to building interactive dashboards, this ebook covers design principles and tooling for effective data communication.

name: TaskFlow Pro
longDescription: TaskFlow Pro streamlines sprints, backlog grooming, and release planning. Integrates with Git providers and supports custom workflows for agile teams.

reviews.author: Priya Sharma
reviews.comment: Solid alternative to heavier PM tools.

reviews.author: Tom Baker
reviews.comment: Our team adopted it within a week.

name: SecureVault Manager
longDescription: SecureVault Manager provides encrypted storage, rotation policies, and audit logs for API keys, certificates, and environment secrets across your infrastructure.

reviews.author: Elena Rossi
reviews.comment: Audit trail alone is worth the price.

name: PixelForge Studio
shortDescription: Creative suite for digital asset production.
longDescription: PixelForge Studio combines vector editing, batch export, and brand kit management for designers and marketing teams building consistent visual assets.

reviews.author: Chris Nguyen
reviews.comment: Intuitive UI with powerful export options.

name: FastAPI Deep Dive
shortDescription: Build production APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic.
longDescription: Twelve modules covering routing, dependency injection, authentication, testing, and deployment. Includes hands-on labs and a capstone e-commerce API project.

reviews.author: Samira Khan
reviews.comment: Best FastAPI course I have taken.

name: Vue 3 Complete Path
shortDescription: Master Composition API, Pinia, and Vue Router.
longDescription: From component fundamentals to state management and testing, this course builds a full storefront application step by step with TypeScript and Vite.

name: Machine Learning Fundamentals
shortDescription: Practical ML from data prep to model deployment.
longDescription: Covers supervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and serving models with REST APIs. Jupyter notebooks and quizzes included.

reviews.author: Robert Kim
reviews.comment: Good balance of theory and practice.

name: TypeScript Design Patterns
longDescription: Explore generics, utility types, and architectural patterns for large Vue and React codebases. Includes refactoring case studies from legacy JavaScript.

name: LogStream Analytics
longDescription: LogStream Analytics aggregates application logs, supports structured queries, alerting rules, and retention policies for DevOps and SRE teams.

name: Docker & Kubernetes Bootcamp
shortDescription: Containerize apps and orchestrate at scale.
longDescription: Hands-on labs for building images, composing services, deploying to Kubernetes, and managing ingress, secrets, and horizontal pod autoscaling.

reviews.author: Hannah Lee
reviews.comment: Labs were well structured and easy to follow.

name: API Security Playbook
shortDescription: Protect REST and GraphQL APIs from common threats.
longDescription: Covers authentication flows, rate limiting, input validation, OWASP API Top 10, and security headers with checklists for production readiness.

reviews.author: Victor Mensah
reviews.comment: Practical checklists I use on every review.

name: CodePulse CI
longDescription: CodePulse CI offers parallel test runners, cache-aware builds, and deployment previews integrated with GitHub and GitLab workflows.

name: Redis Caching Strategies
shortDescription: Speed up APIs with effective cache design.
longDescription: Learn cache invalidation patterns, TTL strategies, session storage, and pub/sub for real-time features. Includes Python and Node examples.

reviews.author: Marcus Webb
reviews.comment: Clear guidance on when not to cache.
